0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East) in the Wizards' ninth game of the season, with Washington coming off a loss and Atlanta on a two-game winning streak. Washington trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 120-105 in Washington on November 4, and it also lost its 2025-26 series to Atlanta 1-3. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) and has Asa Newell, Jalen Johnson and Jock Landale listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions.
